post.text:
Associate Judge Nick Malarao was sworn in as an Associate Judge of Te Koti Matua - High Court at the Auckland High Court on Wednesday 10 June. The ceremony was presided over by the Chief Justice.

Guests were welcomed to the Court with a waiata by the Auckland High Court Waiata Ropu, and mihi whakatau from Justice Natalie Walker.

Speeches were given by Solicitor-General Anna Adams KC on behalf of the Government, Mark Davies on behalf of the profession, and Vinney Kumar on behalf of the Kshatriya and Gujarati communities.

Associate Judge Malarao will sit in Auckland. sen.nz/9c8wdp
